claims.claim: Official frontend guide still says Freighter requires HTTPS to interact with a dapp

sources.quote: Freighter wallet requires a secure connection to interact with your dapp. Browsers treat http://localhost and http://127.0.0.1 as secure contexts per the W3C Secure Contexts specification, so local development over plain HTTP works without extra setup. To enable HTTPS on localhost anyway

claims.notes: Old sentence count 0. Remove canonical-page caution.

claims.claim: http://localhost and http://127.0.0.1 can be potentially trustworthy origins

sources.quote: If origin's host matches one of the CIDR notations 127.0.0.0/8 or ::1/128, return Potentially Trustworthy. If the user agent conforms to let-localhost-be-localhost and host is localhost / localhost. / .localhost, return Potentially Trustworthy. Section 5.2: user agents MAY treat localhost names that way only if localhost never resolves to a non-loopback address.

claims.notes: Keep the user-agent and resolver condition. Do not claim every localhost hostname is trustworthy.

separate isConnected.ts, isAllowed.ts, requestAccess.ts structured return types
